summary: 32-year-old man swimming near the South Bay swim beach at Horsetooth Reservoir went under and did not resurface ~2:33 p.m. Divers located him ~50 minutes later ~45 ft from shore and pulled him from the water; he was flown by helicopter to a local hospital but did not survive. His wife, on the beach, called 911 when she lost sight of him.
location: Horsetooth Reservoir, South Bay swim beach
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office, Larimer County Department of Natural Resources Park Rangers, Poudre Fire Authority, Larimer County Dive Rescue Team
notes: Coroner's office to release identity at a later date; not published in the article.
